items.claim: Alt+Left/Right in a tab's rename field moved the page instead of the caret
A rename cut off by a hold reopened when the hold lifted
A PrefsBar cell's `ctx.source` read sibling and own leaves without their defaults
An image read finishing after a hold still committed
PatternPicker's upload committed through the hold and `onChange` of the render that started it
items.note: duplicate of A's image-read finding, fixed dd8dbd6155; this commit also sends a late read to the current `onChange`

items.claim: The size bar lit "M" for a texture paint and its presses did nothing
items.note: The bar now lights no size and is disabled.

items.claim: A Powerline segment kept a stale left cap from a replaced neighbor
With `over` a `PrefSection`, aliases inside a bar's menu group vanished
items.note: This widens `over` in routing's `MenuSources` and ui's `BarMenuSources` to take a `PrefSection`, with an `api` changeset for both packages.

items.claim: An SVG with only a `viewBox` was stored square
items.note: It now takes its size from the viewBox when it decodes at 0×0. Whether real engines decode it at 0×0 was not checked, since that needs a browser.

items.claim: Plot2D mapped client points with separate x/y scales while the SVG draws with uniform `meet` scaling
items.note: The point now maps through the same uniform scale and centering.

items.claim: A curved PageTabs drew a drop mark at the dragged tab's own slot
items.note: It now matches the straight strip, which also suppresses only the tab's own index and still marks the slot just after it.
